519		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
520		if err != nil {
521			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
522		}
523		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
524			UID: &memoUID,
525		})
526		if err != nil {
527			return nil, err
528		}
529		if memo == nil {
530			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
531		}
532	
533		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
534		if err != nil {
535			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
536		}
537		if user == nil {
538			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
539		}
540		// Only the creator or admin can update the memo.
541		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
542			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
543		}
544	
545		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
546			ContentID: &request.Name,
547		})
548		if err != nil {
549			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
550		}
551	
552		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
553			MemoID: &memo.ID,
554		})
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
557		}
558	
559		deleteRelations, _ := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
560		if memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, deleteRelations); err == nil {
561			// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is deleted.
562			if err := s.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
563				slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo deleted webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
564			}
565		}
566	
567		// Delete memo comments first (store.DeleteMemo handles their relations and attachments)
568		commentType := store.MemoRelationComment
569		relations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID, Type: &commentType})
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo comments")
572		}
573		for _, relation := range relations {
574			if err := s.Store.DeleteMemo(ctx, &store.DeleteMemo{ID: relation.MemoID}); err != nil {
575				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete memo comment")
576			}
577		}
578	
579		// Delete the memo (store.DeleteMemo handles relation and attachment cleanup)
580		if err = s.Store.DeleteMemo(ctx, &store.DeleteMemo{ID: memo.ID}); err != nil {
581			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete memo")
582		}
583	
584		// Broadcast live refresh event.
585		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
586			Type:       SSEEventMemoDeleted,
587			Name:       request.Name,
588			Visibility: memo.Visibility,
589			CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
590		})
591	
592		return &emptypb.Empty{}, nil
593	}
